title: 2 v 2 With Outlets
description: A 2-on-2 possession game with four perimeter outlets. Teams use support players to keep possession and create scoring chances; after a turnover, the new offense must connect with an outlet before attacking.
coaching_points: Scan before receiving and know the available outlet options.
Pass and move to create give-and-go support.
Defenders pressure the puck while protecting passing lanes.
On a regain, connect to an outlet quickly and transition to offense.

title: Sweden 4 v 2 Power Play Game
description: A continuous 4-on-2 special-teams game in a compact home-plate area that trains quick puck movement, seam recognition, penalty-kill sticks, and rapid role rotation.
coaching_points: Move the puck quickly and use the numerical advantage before the penalty kill can reset.
Attack open seams when defenders overcommit.
Penalty killers stay compact with active sticks in passing lanes.
Rotate roles quickly and communicate through each transition.

title: Power Play Scoring Competition
description: A timed power-play competition that starts without pressure and progressively adds penalty killers, forcing the unit to keep producing as defensive pressure increases.
coaching_points: Make fast decisions and move the puck before pressure arrives.
Use crisp, game-like entries and support routes.
Recover loose or imperfect pucks immediately.
Adjust spacing and puck movement as additional penalty killers enter.

title: 3 on 3 Any Net
description: A 3-on-3 game with two nets facing the neutral zone and coach bumpers available for support. After gaining possession, a team must connect with a coach before it can attack either net.
coaching_points: Scan early because either net can become the attack target.
Use support players to create quick give-and-go options.
Communicate and move away from the puck to open space.
Transition immediately when possession changes.

title: 3 on 3 Play Fast
description: A fast 3-on-3 transition game with outside support players. After every turnover, the new offensive team must use an outside player before attacking, creating rapid changes of possession and support.
coaching_points: Find the outside support option immediately after a turnover.
Outside players stay ready for one-touch passes.
Scan before receiving so the next play is already identified.
Use short, intense shifts to keep the pace high.

title: Quick Strike 3 v 1 Circle Game
description: A rapid 3-on-1 game around a faceoff circle with two outside support players and two opposing nets. Possession creates an immediate three-player attack while the defender works to disrupt quick passes and shots.
coaching_points: Move the puck immediately and attack before the defender can recover.
Use deception before passing or shooting.
Outside support players play quickly and stay available.
The defender keeps an active stick and protects the most dangerous lane.

title: 4 on 2 Split Power Play Drill
description: A split-zone 4-on-2 special-teams game. The side with possession attacks with four players while two defenders try to win the puck and connect to teammates on the opposite side.
coaching_points: Use quick puck movement and constant off-puck support.
Find seams and shoot before the penalty killers can reset.
Defenders stay compact with sticks in passing lanes.
On a regain, make a clean tape-to-tape outlet to transition the drill.

title: 2 on 2 Angle Game
description: A 2-on-2 retrieval and forecheck game that teaches attackers to escape pressure while forecheckers angle and create turnovers. A successful forecheck can earn an extra attacker and turn the play into a 3-on-2.
coaching_points: F1 applies controlled pressure while F2 supports the forecheck.
Use stick-on-puck and body position to angle the breakout.
Transition immediately when the puck changes hands.
Communicate and scan before committing to pressure.

title: Corner Houda
description: A corner battle game that begins with a rimmed puck and develops into a 3-on-3 possession fight. The offense attacks the net while the defense works to recover, protect the middle, and exit the zone.
coaching_points: Win wall retrievals with body position and close puck support.
Defenders protect net-front and slot layers while applying pressure.
Keep sticks in lanes and angle attackers away from the middle.
Communicate through possession changes and transition quickly.

title: 2 on 2 Net to Corner
description: A compact 2-on-2 corner game with the net set on an angle. Each team must tag up behind a designated line after gaining possession before it can attack, emphasizing puck protection and fast reads under pressure.
coaching_points: Protect the puck with strong body position along the wall.
Shoulder-check and scan before receiving or turning.
Move the puck quickly when pressure closes.
Defenders pressure with purpose and anticipate the next option.
